Benchmark projects in China

National infrastructure where Tianyu transformers and switchgear have been in service, from the Three Gorges in 1998 to offshore wind in 2023.

1998Hydropower

Three Gorges Project, Wanglingmiao 35 kV substation

Tianyu ZK1-10 metal-clad switchgear, the only centrally installed switchgear of many bidders to enter the project.

2020Hydropower

Baihetan Hydropower Station, Ningnan power project

Switchgear and prefabricated cabins for the world’s second-largest hydropower station.

2019Grid, high altitude

Shuanghu Duoma 110 kV substation, Nagqu, Xizang

Main transformer and C-GIS for the highest-altitude project of its kind.

2021Renewable energy

Datang Xiangshan 300 MW tidal-flat PV, Zhejiang

Single-unit largest-capacity 220 kV double-split transformer and 35 kV switchgear.

2023Offshore wind

Three Gorges Zhangpu Liu’ao 400 MW offshore wind, Fujian

Tower ring main units for large offshore wind turbines.

2010Landmark buildings

Shanghai World Expo venues

China’s largest-capacity 16,000 kVA dry-type transformer at the time.
